name: Omaha
tagline: Four hole cards — use exactly two of them with three from the board.
rulesSummary: Win everyone's chips. Run out and you're out; the last player with chips wins.
The two players left of the dealer post the small and big blinds (with two players, the dealer posts the small one). Everyone gets four cards face down.
Four rounds of betting: before the flop, after the flop (3 shared cards), after the turn (1 more) and after the river (1 more). No limit: bet up to all your chips.
Your hand must use exactly two of your cards and exactly three from the board. Four ♥ on the board make no flush unless you hold two ♥.
Best to worst: straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card. Aces are high, or low in A-2-3-4-5.
The last player in, or the best hand at the showdown, takes the pot. Ties split it.
